List.Title: Petri lights
List.Subtitle: Northern friends
List.Body: We met Petri back in 2016, and have been working together since. This is a small tribute to him. Thank you Petri! You’ve been such an incredible partner on this journey. While I’m writing these lines I can imagine you laughing, and that’s enough reward. Thank you my Finnish friend.
List.Author: Sky Dirson
List.Quote: The world is a mirror, forever reflecting what you are doing, within yourself.

List.Title: Best museums
List.Subtitle: Extraordinary exhibitions and collections of modern and contemporary art
List.Body: The 20th and 21st centuries have witnessed an amazing amount of development in art, artistic movements rising, staking out their place, and then stepping to the side to make way for something new.
List.Author: Janis Spector
List.Quote: Today,museums are busier and more exciting and attractive

List.Title: Traveling matters
List.Subtitle: The happier you are, the healthier you are
List.Body:
The UN’s World Tourism Organization established that the happiest people on earth travel more. Travel makes us happy, here’s why.
Studies have shown that we value our experiences more than any material possessions we may own.

Through trips, you get to meet new people, people that you otherwise would never have met, which contributes to your happiness in life.
List.Author: Regina Joplin
List.Quote: Traveling – it leaves you speechless, then turns you into a storyteller

List.Title: A peaceful home
List.Subtitle: Make your place a Stress-Free Sanctuary
List.Body:
Certain decorating choices can help you to feel this sense of peace, and have a huge impact while you're in it. And yet, stress is a defining feature of contemporary life—this past year, 55% of Americans reported experiencing a lot of stress on a daily basis.

Good design might not be able to intervene in a cultural existential crisis, but it can help build spaces that calm and restore us.
List.Author: Ivy Zeroth
List.Quote: “Your home either nurtures and supports you or depletes your energy and leaves you exhausted,

List.Title: Family quality time
List.Subtitle: Establish a fun, frequent and meaningful family time routine
List.Body:
Any time spent together is good, but the most effective time together is meaningful time. Time without distractions and taking part in activities enjoyable for all family. It also includes sincere conversations and genuine praise.

Spend the time relaxing and talking with each other. You might be surprised by the things you learn about your kids on your special night or how you connect as a family.
List.Author: Steve Stone
List.Quote: The memories we make with our family is everything

List.Title: A tea with yourself?
List.Subtitle: How Tea Benefits Your Self-Care Routine
List.Body:
A cup of tea has surprising benefits that can improve your emotional health, help you sleep, calm your anxiety, and settle your tummy.

The pace to make a tea is slow, calm and tranquil and the beverage at the end should be soothing and nurturing
List.Author: Sky Dirson
List.Quote: Sometimes all you need is a good cup of Tea
